notes.title: Update Notes 15/12/2024
notes.content:
Update Notes 15/12/2024

update v1.2.0 changing the name of the game urgently due to problems in Brazil with the previous name, now in the team's decision the name has changed to Living Sim

notes.title: Minor Update/Patch Notes 12/10/2024
notes.content:
12/10/2024
In this version 1.1.0 of the infamous Brazil

-The farm has been added where you can manage the cattle farm and sell milk
-There is a new explorable map in this new "expansion" which will have changes throughout the updates
- problems with electrician jobs were fixed
-bugs were fixed in the employment of plumbers at the water center
-We fixed some frame defects throughout the city by removing unnecessary shadows
-We made a small adjustment to the game's Tablet and GPSMap
-we updated the chat on the tablet where you can chat for now only in Portuguese
-vehicle on the farm has been added 
-New Furniture in the tablet's online store has been added 
-changes in some textures 
-restocker jobs in the market have been updated for better performance 
-We have released the option to place furniture in various places with the option to delete everything with ''delete''
-Added headlights to vehicles by pressing the ''L'' key
